title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks could cause automation…
description: Splunk SOAR versions prior to 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permissions to edit and run playbooks can disrupt automation batches for other events. This occurs because the playbook API requests are not properly bound to the server-provided execution context, allowing interference with concurrent automation processes.
